summary: Iter 117 — tested Admin suppression définitive + purge, Leads mark-viewed, E-invoicing reconcile/unreconcile, and ProUpsell/Stripe checkout gating for particulier. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed. Frontend: full UI e2e passed: (1) admin can delete a disposable particulier from /admin?tab=users via admin-delete-user-{id} → confirm-dialog-title → confirm → toast 'Compte X supprimé · N enregistrement(s) purgé(s)' → user gone from API list; admin rows correctly have NO delete button (data-testid absent, '—' rendered). (2) Pro reconcile UI: /factures-electroniques shows einv-reconcile-btn-{inv_id} per row → dialog einv-reconcile-dialog opens with einv-recon-order-select (shadcn combobox) + einv-recon-expected-input + einv-recon-confirm → gap block einv-recon-{inv_id} and einv-recon-gap-{inv_id} render with signed amount + pct ('+1 669 € (+1668.6%)') → einv-unreconcile-{inv_id} removes reconciliation with toast 'Rapprochement retiré'. (3) Particulier /factures → redirect to /passez-pro (only Pro plans: upsell-plan-pro_monthly + upsell-plan-pro_business_monthly); /scanner-devis → /passez-pro?feature=analyse with Premium (upsell-plan-premium_monthly) + both Pro plans, and separate 'Pour les particuliers' / 'Pour les professionnels' sections. Clicking upsell-checkout-pro_monthly triggers POST /billing/checkout → HTTP 200 (backend tests confirmed 'url' returned for both premium and pro plans).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py delete_user: correctly guards role=='admin' and self-delete with 403; iterates a comprehensive _PURGE_COLLECTIONS list with try/except per collection (robust). Consider also purging by 'owner_user_id' / 'created_by' fields in some collections (e.g., organizations, quotes) since current purge is only keyed on user_id — data owned via other keys may linger. Not blocking.

routes/leads.py mark_mine_viewed: idempotent update_many with {'viewed': {'$ne': True}} — good. Returns modified_count as 'marked'. GET /leads/mine correctly exposes 'viewed' field (since projection is {'_id': 0}).
routes/einvoicing.py _gap: gap_flag logic ('ok' if |pct|<=2, else 'over' if diff>0 else 'under') matches doc and behaves correctly on live data.
routes/billing.py checkout: raises 502 on Stripe error with detail; consider not leaking exception string in prod. Not blocking (FREE_PROMO_MODE preview).
